description: Single source of truth for audit finding IDs and their status across audits. Append, never renumber.

severityModel.Critical: Likely to cause severe compromise, data loss or a major system failure
severityModel.High: Significant security, reliability or functionality concern
severityModel.Medium: Meaningful maintainability, usability, operational or performance concern

audits.note: Reported 3.9 used a weight total of 100; the weights actually sum to 105. Normalised value is 4.07.

audits.commit: Working tree on feature/erd-schema-and-pdf (not yet committed)
audits.note: Reported score capped at 6.5 while High findings F-23 (payment end-to-end unverified) remains open.

findings.title: Anyone can self-register as Employee (staff)
findings.remainingAction: Review existing live accounts that self-registered as Employee and revoke where needed.

history.evidence: Register always assigns Donor; Employee is granted from Staff Access (audited) or StaffAccess:BootstrapEmployeeEmails. Tests: Registration_AlwaysCreatesDonor_EvenWhenEmployeeRoleIsPosted, RegisterPage_NoLongerOffersAnEmployeeOption, StaffAccess_GrantIsAuditedAndSelfRevokeIsRefused.

findings.title: Anonymous Azure Function returns any donor certificate by sequential id
findings.remainingAction: Confirm in Azure whether an old anonymous version is deployed; redeploy or delete it.

history.evidence: AuthorizationLevel.Function, lookup by 32-character TransactionReference, Verified donations only (GenerateTaxCertificateFunction.cs). Builds in CI.

findings.title: Project totals inflated by unpaid or fake donations
findings.remainingAction: Run Funding Reconciliation on the live database after deployment.

history.evidence: DonationService.CaptureAsync never changes FundsRaised; Funding Reconciliation detects and corrects legacy inflation. Tests: Donate_RecordsPendingDonation_RedirectsToPayFast_AndDoesNotTouchProjectTotal, FundingReconciliation_RecalculateUsesOfflinePlusVerifiedOnly. LocalDB smoke test flagged a legacy R 715 difference.

findings.title: Payment confirmation double-counts and failures never reverse

history.evidence: Single increment on Verified, replay-safe, Failed never touches totals, rowversion retry. Tests: Notify_Complete_VerifiesOnceAndAddsRandAmountOnce_EvenIfReplayed, Notify_Failed_MarksDonationFailedWithoutChangingTotals.

findings.title: USD/EUR amounts summed 1:1 with rand
findings.remainingAction: Rates are indicative configuration; see F-46.

history.evidence: AmountZar and ExchangeRateToZar stored at capture; all totals in rand; migration backfills history (verified on LocalDB). Test: Donate_ForeignCurrency_IsChargedInRandAtConfiguredRate.

findings.title: Donation flow never sends the donor to PayFast
findings.remainingAction: End-to-end payment not yet verified: blocked by F-23.

history.evidence: Checkout wired with return/cancel/notify URLs; smoke test on LocalDB produced a correctly signed sandbox redirect for the rand amount (USD 10 → amount=185.00).

findings.title: Tax certificates issued for unpaid donations; fake registration number
findings.remainingAction: Configure real PBO details and set Organisation:IsDemo=false only when legally entitled.

history.evidence: Certificates only for Verified donations; issuer from Organisation configuration; demonstration watermark until a PBO reference is configured. Tests: Certificates_OnlyForOwnersOfVerifiedDonations, Issuer_IsOfficialOnlyWhenNotDemoAndPboConfigured.

findings.title: Known-vulnerable System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs 9.0.11

history.evidence: Pinned 10.0.14 (first patched 10.0.13). dotnet list package --vulnerable --include-transitive reports none for all four projects.

findings.title: No privacy notice or consent for volunteer and donor personal data (POPIA)
findings.remainingAction: Legal review; appoint an Information Officer; automate retention and deletion.

history.evidence: Privacy notice written; consent checkbox and timestamp on Donate, Volunteer and Contact. Tests: Volunteer_WithoutConsent_IsNotSaved, Contact_RecordsConsentTimestamp, PrivacyPage_IsARealNoticeNotTheTemplate.

findings.title: Live site may run in Development with published staff credentials
findings.remainingAction: Owner must confirm ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Production on App Service and remove or rotate demo accounts there (cannot be verified from the repository).

history.evidence: Demo accounts are seeded only in Development or with Seed:DemoData=true; README no longer advertises a live staff login.

findings.title: Model/migration drift hidden by suppressed PendingModelChangesWarning

history.evidence: Suppression removed; design-time factory removed; duplicate raw-SQL constraints dropped; orphan migration deleted; CI drift check. has-pending-model-changes reports none.

findings.title: Data Protection keys not persisted

history.evidence: PersistKeysToDbContext with a DataProtectionKeys table.

findings.title: Migrations run at startup on every instance
findings.remainingAction: Set Database:MigrateOnStartup=false in production and add the script step to the release.

history.evidence: Database:MigrateOnStartup switch; idempotent migrate.sql produced by CI and Azure Pipelines.

findings.title: CD publishes images without CI passing

history.evidence: cd.yml runs on workflow_run of a successful CI run on main, with explicit permissions.

findings.title: No rate limiting on public forms and login
findings.remainingAction: Consider CAPTCHA if abuse is observed.

history.evidence: Per-IP fixed-window limiter on POST requests, webhook exempt. Test: PublicPosts_AreLimitedPerClient_ButTheWebhookIsNot.

findings.title: Invalid input causes 500s and errors are not displayed

history.evidence: AllowedValues/Range validation, validation summaries on all forms, project checked before insert. Test: Donate_InvalidInput_RedisplaysFormInsteadOfServerError (5 cases).

findings.title: No backups or disaster recovery procedure
findings.remainingAction: Confirm the Azure SQL retention tier, perform and record a test restore.

history.evidence: Procedure documented in deliverable 07; no restore has been tested.

findings.title: Fabricated statistics and organisation details on a public site

history.evidence: Live ImpactStats view component; Organisation configuration; demonstration badge; illustrative stories labelled. Test: HomePage_ShowsLiveFiguresInsteadOfHardCodedStatistics.

findings.title: Missing security headers, Subresource Integrity and host filtering
findings.remainingAction: CSP still allows 'unsafe-inline'; set AllowedHosts per environment.

history.evidence: CSP, X-Frame-Options, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy; SRI on the CDN stylesheet. Test: Responses_CarrySecurityHeaders.

findings.title: PayFast ITN lacks amount/merchant checks; passphrase optional

history.evidence: Amount and merchant validated; live mode refuses to start without a passphrase or with the sandbox merchant. Tests: Notify_AmountMismatch_IsRefusedAndDonationStaysPending, Notify_WrongMerchant_IsRefused, PayFastOptionsValidatorTests.

findings.title: Historical migration fails on every empty SQL Server database (rowversion ALTER)

history.evidence: Found while verifying migrations on LocalDB. The AlterColumn on ReliefProjects.RowVersion in P1PaymentsEmailAndStatuses was removed (SQL Server cannot alter a rowversion column). Full chain now applies to an empty database; CI migrations job guards it.

findings.title: Identity key-length drift (AddDefaultIdentity 128 vs schema 450) crashed startup once the warning was unsuppressed

history.evidence: Stores.MaxLengthForKeys = 0 keeps the runtime model equal to the existing schema; app verified starting on the migrated LocalDB database.

findings.title: Shared PayFast sandbox merchant rejects every signed request; payments unverified end to end
findings.remainingAction: Register an own PayFast sandbox merchant, set PayFast:Passphrase, run a sandbox payment with a public NotifyUrl and record the evidence.

history.evidence: Signature string matches PayFast's documented PHP algorithm byte for byte; the sandbox answers 'signature does not match' for every variant (GET/POST, with/without the documented passphrase) but accepts unsigned requests, so the shared merchant's passphrase is unknown.

findings.title: Transitive System.Security.Cryptography.Xml advisories (three High)

history.evidence: Surfaced when Data Protection storage was added; Microsoft packages aligned on 10.0.14; audit clean.

findings.title: Private Azure Artifacts feed breaks clean restore; dependency-confusion exposure

history.evidence: NU1301 401 reproduced on restore of a new package; packageSourceMapping (only GiftOfTheGivers.Helpers from the private feed) and auditSources = nuget.org added.

findings.title: Developer database contains migration 20260924223317_SnapshotSync that is not in the repository
findings.remainingAction: Confirm whether any shared or live database contains it; recreate local databases from repository migrations.

history.evidence: Observed read-only in __EFMigrationsHistory of the local GiftOfTheGiversDb.

findings.title: Class-level Donor role blocked employees from certificate actions

history.evidence: Roles declared per action. Test: DonorPortal_ForbidsEmployeeOnlyUsersButCertificatesAllowThem.

findings.title: Staff changes not audited; wrong audit action names

history.evidence: Audit entries with details for projects, updates, volunteer decisions and assignments, inquiries, staff access, exports, reconciliation and payment events.

findings.title: Azure Function references the whole web project
findings.remainingAction: Extract a shared data project (implementation plan T-2.3).

history.evidence: Deferred: low risk once the function is key-protected.

findings.title: Unbounded staff lists (no pagination)

history.evidence: Server-side paging for donations, volunteers, inquiries and the audit log.

findings.title: Culture-dependent money formatting

history.evidence: Money helper; no ToString("C") left in views. Tests: MoneyTests.

findings.title: Volunteer date of birth fabricated when not supplied

history.evidence: DateOfBirth and PhoneNumber nullable and never invented. Test: Volunteer_WithoutDateOfBirth_StoresNullInsteadOfInventingOne.

findings.title: Design-time DbContext factory hard-coded to LocalDB

history.evidence: Factory removed; dotnet ef builds the model from the app host and its configuration.

findings.title: Helpers publish workflow fails on duplicate source; script-injection pattern

findings.title: Login lockout-on-failure not enabled by the default Identity UI; no staff MFA
findings.remainingAction: Scaffold the Login page with lockoutOnFailure: true; require MFA for the Employee role.

history.evidence: Lockout options configured and POST rate limiting mitigates brute force, but the default Login page does not count failures.

findings.remainingAction: Implement PayFast subscriptions with per-payment child donations.

history.evidence: Relabelled 'Monthly pledge' with honest copy on the form, receipt and README.

history.evidence: Opt-in ForwardedHeaders:Enabled configuration.

history.evidence: Email delivery errors are logged, not thrown.
